description.en: Use it to write an answer onto one card.
description.zh: 用来把一段回答写到同一张卡片上。

source.attribution: Preview of a card that grows across timed edits. No third-party media.
source.materials: No third-party images, fonts or network assets.

summary.en: A local preview of one card receiving five edits, then a check. No third-party media.
summary.zh: 本机预览：同一张卡片接受五次写入，写完再核对。不含第三方素材。

summary.en: A block lands every 700ms. After five blocks it waits 1.8 seconds, clears, and writes again.
summary.zh: 每 700ms 补一块。五块到齐后停 1.8 秒，清空，再写。

fit.en: An answer should land on one card while someone is still reading it.
fit.zh: 一段回答要落在同一张卡片上，人还看着的时候。

avoid.en: The sentences in the card are a sample. Replace them with your own.
avoid.zh: 卡片里的句子只是样本。用的时候换成你自己的。

previewHint.en: Watch this card fill in. Reset starts it again.
previewHint.zh: 看这张卡片补完。重置从头来。

integration.en: Open example.html. Keep one card element and append blocks on a timer. Check the result after the last edit.
integration.zh: 从 example.html 看。保留同一张卡片，按计时把块补上去。最后一次写完再核对。

accessibility.en: The status line says Writing, then Done. Reduced motion shows the finished card.
accessibility.zh: 状态行写着「还在写」，到齐后改成「写完了」。开了减少动态效果时，直接给出写完的卡片。

usage.mount: Open example.html. The card reveals five blocks, 500ms apart.
usage.requirements: A browser that can run the example page.

description.en: An embedded panel that follows your pointer and settles with an interruptible spring.
description.zh: 嵌入页面的拖动面板。跟随手势，松手后弹簧回位，途中可再次抓住。

source.attribution: Original local skill-samples reading panel, 2026-09-08; modularized for Design parts. Not an Apple component.
source.materials: No third-party images, fonts or network assets.

summary.en: Original local skill-samples reading panel, retaining the gesture parameters in an independent module. Not an Apple component; no third-party images, fonts or network assets.
summary.zh: 来源：原有 skill-samples 跟手阅读面板，保留机制参数并提炼为独立模块。不是 Apple 官方组件；不含第三方图片、字体或网络素材。

summary.en: The pointer controls position directly. Release to settle at one of two resting positions. Grab the handle again to interrupt the spring.
summary.zh: 拖动时直接跟手。松手后，根据位置与速度选择停靠点。回弹途中重新抓住横条，即可打断弹簧。

fit.en: A reading or detail panel contained within a page region, with two resting positions.
fit.zh: 页面区域内的阅读或详情面板，具有展开和收起两个停靠位置。

avoid.en: Not a modal dialog. No focus trap or page scroll lock. No React/Vue adapter or real-phone certification.
avoid.zh: 不是模态弹层，不提供焦点约束或页面滚动锁定；没有 React/Vue 适配，也未做真实手机验收。

integration.en: Start with example.html. Change content and CSS variables; call destroy() when removing the panel.
integration.zh: 从 example.html 开始。替换内容与 CSS 变量，移除面板时调用 destroy()。

accessibility.en: Keyboard actions switch immediately. System reduced motion is respected. Collapsed content is not focusable.
accessibility.zh: 键盘操作即时切换。尊重系统的减少动态效果设置。收起的正文不可聚焦。

usage.requirements: Modern browsers with ES modules, Pointer Events, ResizeObserver and inert. Serve examples over HTTP, not file://.

description.en: A native button that gently compresses on press. CSS only, with instant keyboard activation.
description.zh: 按下时轻微缩小，松开后复位。只需 CSS，键盘触发不播放缩放。

source.attribution: Extracted from the locally authored skill-samples buttons, 2026-09-08. Keeps the 0.97 pressed scale and 100ms duration; uses the reviewed strong ease-out curve.
source.materials: No third-party images, fonts, artwork or network assets.

summary.en: From the locally authored skill-samples buttons: scale 0.97 and 100ms. The easing curve comes from the reviewed menu example. No third-party media.
summary.zh: 来自本地制作的 skill-samples 按钮：按下缩放 0.97、过渡 100ms；缓动曲线来自同组菜单评审样本。不包含第三方素材。

summary.en: A transform transition follows the native active state. Repeated presses retarget from the current scale; releasing outside does not activate the button.
summary.zh: transform 过渡跟随原生按下状态。连续按压从当前缩放继续变化；移出按钮后松手不触发操作。

fit.en: Native action buttons that need subtle pointer or touch feedback while keeping the project's own click behavior.
fit.zh: 需要轻微按压反馈的原生操作按钮，保留项目已有的点击行为。

avoid.en: Not a loading or async-state controller, link replacement or complete button design system. Use real button elements and native disabled. Real phones have not been checked.
avoid.zh: 不提供加载或异步状态管理，不替代链接，也不是完整按钮设计系统。使用真实 button 和原生 disabled；未做真实手机检查。

previewHint.en: Press and hold, or focus with Tab and use Space.
previewHint.zh: 按住按钮试试，或用 Tab 聚焦后按空格。

integration.en: Load press-feedback.css and add class="press-feedback" to a native button. Keep your click handler; change CSS variables for colors and spacing. No mount function or cleanup is needed.
integration.zh: 引入 press-feedback.css，给原生 button 添加 press-feedback 类。保留自己的点击处理，用 CSS 变量调整配色和间距。无需初始化或销毁函数。

accessibility.en: Native Enter and Space activation. Focus-visible keyboard use and reduced motion skip scaling. Disabled buttons stay disabled; hover styling only applies to a fine pointer.
accessibility.zh: 保留原生回车和空格激活。键盘焦点和减少动态效果模式不缩放。禁用按钮不响应；悬停样式仅作用于精细指针。

usage.reducedMotion: System preference is automatic. Add the boolean data-reduced-motion attribute to disable scaling for an individual button.
usage.requirements: A native button in a browser supporting :focus-visible and prefers-reduced-motion. Behavior and state are owned by the consuming project.
